name: Adaptive Biotechnologies
outlook:
What Adaptive Biotechnologies says to expect

  • Full year 2026: MRD revenueAdaptive Biotechnologies expects full year revenue for the MRD business to be between $276 million and $286 million, updated from the previous range between $268 million and $278 million.
  • Full year 2026: operating expensesWe expect full year total company operating expenses, including cost of revenue, to be approximately $350 million, updated from the previous range between $350 million and $355 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
